objective: Preallocate SSTable iterator block entry buffers from known block entry counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate SSTable block entry buffer
tasks.result: SsTableIterator now reserves entry-buffer capacity for the first entry and for parsed block counts bounded by block length.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The iterator entry queue now starts with capacity for the first decoded block entry.
After reading a block count, the iterator reserves at most the number of entries that can fit in the block by minimum encoded entry size.
The optimization only changes VecDeque allocation; SSTable block IO, CRC handling, lower-bound filtering, entry order, Fusion scans, compaction, and DML behavior are unchanged.
The full sql_dml regression emitted existing SSTable retry warnings after passing; the command exited successfully.
